hook: The general who founded modern Turkey and remade it from top to bottom.

pages.x: Mustafa was born in 1881 in Salonica, now Thessaloniki in Greece, then a city of the Ottoman Empire. A maths teacher gave him the name Kemal, "perfection". He trained as an army officer.

In 1915 he helped hold back the British and French invasion at Gallipoli. He told his men: "I do not order you to attack, I order you to die." A piece of shrapnel struck the watch in his breast pocket.

After the Ottoman defeat in the First World War, the Allies occupied the empire and planned to carve up Anatolia. Kemal led the resistance from Ankara, and by 1922 had driven out the invading Greek army.
In 1923 he founded the Republic of Turkey, with Ankara as its capital, and became its first president. The next year he abolished the caliphate.
In 1928 he replaced the Arabic script with a Latin alphabet, and toured the country with a blackboard, teaching it himself in town squares.
He separated religion from the state, brought in European-style laws, banned the fez, and in 1934 gave women the vote, before France or Italy.
In 1934 everyone in Turkey had to take a surname. Parliament gave him the name Atatürk, "Father of the Turks", and no one else may use it.

He ruled with a single party and crushed opposition and Kurdish revolts. He died in Istanbul in 1938. Every year on 10 November, at 9:05 in the morning, the moment he died, Turkey stops for a minute of silence.
Atatürk founded modern Turkey and turned it into a secular republic, with a new alphabet, new laws and the vote for women.
pts: Gave Turkey a new alphabet and votes for women
